title: Algorithms and responsibilities
paragraphs: Our script advances a target only after fresh estimated position stays inside the tolerance for 2 seconds.
PX4 estimates motion and uses position, velocity, attitude and rate feedback to generate actuators. CopterSim integrates the stock dynamics.
UE renders scene pixels. A separate process copies frames and writes files. No image-based controller ran.
notes: https://docs.px4.io/v1.12/en/flight_stack/controller_diagrams and tuning_the_ecl_ekf accessed 2026-10-11. B1 ULog SYS_MC_EST_GROUP=2 and estimator topics support EKF2 configuration. Conceptual cascaded P/PID structure is documented, internal loop signals not independently validated. No dynamics calibration. title: Native calibration and clock limits
paragraphs: Initial camera minus body was (0.3,0,-0.15) m despite the requested (0.3,0,0) mount. Actor-origin explanation is unresolved.
FOV axis, projection, optical axes, color/orientation and achieved extrinsics need independent checks for native calibrated images.
Acquisition UTC is unknown. A2 began with an old-looking image clock. No latency or geometric pass follows from receiver timestamps.

title: Applicability and research inputs
paragraphs: Residential, suburban and campus views below 100 m remain fidelity research questions. No real reconstruction entered this audit.
Sparse capture means missing view coverage. Sparse scene content means limited physical/perceptual structure. They need different evaluations.
Indoor navigation and racing are untested tasks. C lacks a compatible released policy path. That does not erase component usefulness.

title: Minimal follow-up and interface learning
paragraphs: No restart is needed for the control/native-baseline decision. Optional recovery of missing files would take about 15–20 minutes.
Only measure the selected role next: external motion mapping, native calibrated replay, or our cleanup helper. Do not repeat every passed flight.
Understand NED/FRD versus camera axes, estimate versus truth, ACK versus achieved state, distinct clocks, and SITL versus physical HITL.
